description: Where a value in a *_source field came from. Written by the import, never mapped; apps read it to tell delivered values (gis) from values the import derived or inferred. Which codes a field may hold is in that field's `code_subset`.

codes.label: Derived: shared with a coincident end / point (within 1 cm)
Derived: a new reference for an end with no other (c:<x>_<y>)
Derived: from the connected network (the pipe or node the asset sits on)
Derived: on a boundary, both areas held in dma_boundary_refs
Derived: from the area polygon the asset lies in
Inferred from other delivered columns (a documented fallback)
